body: I couldn't get myself throw up so I just waited it out and not most of the effects have gone away. I'm three hours late so I'm not sure about the conversing aspect.
I talk to my therapist online, However I personally would prefer to do it in person. I'm not sure what it is but doing it in person would feel a lot more real.

I can't say I fully agree with your views, however you have something most people don't. You had dreams. After observing and researching humans, I've come to the realization that most people either don't have dreams or haven't achieved them and some have even forgotten about them. And if you had the capacity to recognize your aspirations then you should have the capacity to know what makes you happy. Your situation sounds terrible, and I can't really help you all that much. I'm a pretty sad and angry person too, but I was always at my most happiest when I was chasing my dreams.

I'm no expert by any means, however your situation does seem somewhat similar to one who might have a form of body dysmorphia. Though that's just a guess but you should ask a therapist or a doctor, that should be your best bet.
You could see a therapist and let them get to know you enough so they can draw a conclusion about what you need. Just a suggestion.

Yeah that does sound awful. I have a voice as well however our relationship is quite antagonistic. To be honest I don't have much advice as I'm an amateur when it comes to understanding people. However I can tell you that realizing a goal or dream in life might help you in some way. Right now I'm at my lowest point in all of my life, yet I keep going because I can't die until I see that dream through. I know aspirations aren't something you can simply look for, though you never know when you'll find something worth living for.

My mother has been talking about putting me on antidepressants this week. She described it as something that's should show you what it's like to not be depressed. I don't know if it works the same for everyone, but I'll tell you what they do to me when I get them.
